trigger: The first full TSMOM-ALPHA-0029 attempt stopped before PNL because 33 held symbol-days had no next-day return; the first examples were all on 2022-02-26 across unrelated USD-M perpetuals.

external_evidence.binance_public_data_policy: Binance documents both daily and monthly public market-data archives and states that archived kline files may later be updated when inconsistencies are discovered.
external_evidence.known_multi_symbol_gap_pattern: A public binance-public-data issue documents a separate 2022 USD-M futures kline interval missing simultaneously across many unrelated contracts, supporting treatment of clustered gaps as archive-data defects rather than automatic delistings.

repair_rule.primary_source: official Binance USD-M monthly 1d kline archive
repair_rule.fallback_source: official Binance USD-M daily 1d kline archive for the exact missing internal calendar date only
repair_rule.eligible_for_fallback: a calendar date strictly between the symbol's first and last monthly-archive daily bars that is missing from the assembled monthly history
repair_rule.acceptance: daily fallback ZIP must parse to exactly the requested UTC open date with numeric close and quote volume
repair_rule.if_daily_file_absent_or_invalid: leave the gap unresolved; do not interpolate, forward-fill, synthesize price/volume, or assume zero return
repair_rule.eligibility_recalculation: recompute the same frozen 240-contiguous-day + $25m completed-day-volume PIT eligibility on the repaired history before any target or PNL calculation
repair_rule.execution_validation: any held position that still lacks a next-day return after the official daily fallback remains a hard failure

prohibited: no change to TSMOM signal, 30d vol, gross, costs, funding, qualification gates, age threshold or liquidity threshold
no inspection of strategy PNL before the repair rule is applied
required_diagnostics: number of internal monthly gaps detected
number repaired from official daily 1d files
whether any held return remains missing after repair
